name: Auth Forms (Login / Register)
summary: Passive, labelled authentication-entry shell composing canonical Form, field, action, link, and divider dependencies while targets own credentials, requests, sessions, providers, and account access.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Section labelled by its visible authentication-flow title; omitted when title or Form composition is invalid.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Required title and optional supporting-copy group.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible heading that labels the authentication section.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Complete canonical Form composition containing target-owned fields, validation, and primary submission.

anatomy.name: forgot
anatomy.description: Optional recovery navigation wrapper containing a canonical Link.

anatomy.name: divider
anatomy.description: Optional visible method label arranged between two decorative canonical Dividers.

anatomy.name: dividerRule
anatomy.description: Decorative canonical Divider instance; two are composed around the label when it exists.

anatomy.name: social
anatomy.description: Target-owned alternative authentication actions composed from canonical Buttons.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional account-mode navigation or legal content composed with canonical Link when navigational.

states.name: default
states.description: Valid title plus required Form composition.

states.name: withRecovery
states.description: Optional canonical password-recovery Link is present.

states.name: withAlternatives
states.description: One or more target-owned alternative authentication Buttons are present.

states.name: withFooter
states.description: Optional account-mode navigation or legal footer is present.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Trimmed title and complete Form are required; invalid required content omits the whole shell rather than leaving an unnamed or non-functional surface.

behavior.name: formSubmission
behavior.description: Form and field dependencies preserve native value, validity, autofill, paste, keyboard, submission, and reset; the target owns credential handling and responses.

behavior.name: passwordComposition
behavior.description: Canonical Password Input owns the single password value and visibility action; U1 does not mirror the secret or duplicate reveal behavior.

behavior.name: recoveryNavigation
behavior.description: Recovery is native Link navigation to the target-owned route or flow.

behavior.name: alternativeAuthentication
behavior.description: Alternative methods cannot submit the credential Form accidentally and hand off to the target provider or hosted flow.

behavior.name: targetLifecycle
behavior.description: Pending, disabled policy, generic server errors, announcements, focus, rate limits, MFA/passkeys, redirects, session truth, and account access remain target-owned and are composed outside U1.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete Auth Forms shell when title is empty or whitespace-only.
properties.description: Non-empty visible title that labels the authentication section.

properties.name: form
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete Auth Forms shell when no complete Form is supplied.
properties.description: Complete canonical Form containing target-owned named fields, validation, primary submission, and optional recovery Link.

properties.name: forgotAction
properties.description: Canonical Link composition for target-owned password or account recovery navigation.

properties.name: dividerLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the labelled Divider composition while retaining valid individually named alternative actions.
properties.description: Optional visible localized label separating primary and alternative authentication methods.

properties.name: socialActions
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete alternatives region and its divider.
properties.description: Target-owned alternative authentication actions such as social providers, SSO, or email link, composed from canonical Buttons; the accepted property name is retained for compatibility.

properties.name: footer
properties.description: Optional supporting account-mode navigation or legal content; navigation composes canonical Link.

accessibility: Use a section labelled by the required visible title; do not invent an authentication ARIA role or composite keyboard model.
Associate every native field with a visible label and target-supplied text feedback; aria-invalid is reserved for actual error state.
Use correct native type, name, and autocomplete purpose tokens and do not block paste, autofill, password managers, or the canonical password reveal action.
Alternative authentication Buttons need method- or provider-specific names and type=button so they cannot submit the credential Form accidentally.
Password recovery and account-mode navigation use canonical Links with real target destinations.
Target error responses should avoid disclosing account existence and own announcements, focus, pending, disabled, retry, rate-limit, MFA/passkey, redirect, and session behavior.
Access to account data remains target-authenticated; a visible U1 shell does not establish authentication or authorization.

Canonical Button, Link, Divider, Input, Password Input, Field Wrapper, and Form retain their keyboard, focus, contrast, forced-colors, reduced-motion, validation, and controlled or uncontrolled behavior.

web.notes: Labelled passive shell implemented in Account CSS and composed from canonical Form, field, action, Link, and Divider contracts with no U1 runtime.

shopify.notes: Shopify v1 delegates authentication to the current hosted authorization/account experience and authenticated Customer Account API or extension profile; it does not render a theme-owned U1 credential form. Classic Liquid requires a separately versioned compatibility adapter. Live handoff or headless proof remains required before target readiness.
